Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

translations.web: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
translations.bsb: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
translations.kjv: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
translations.asv: He will cut off the spirit of princes: He is terrible to the kings of the earth. Psalm 77 For the Chief Musician; after the manner of Jeduthan. A Psalm of Asaph.
